zh: 比赛前我们总是先热身十分钟。
en: We always {warm up|stretch} for ten minutes before the game.

zh: 跑完步花五分钟做做放松运动。
en: Take five minutes to {cool down|warm down|stretch|recover|rest} after your run.

zh: 他每周去健身房锻炼三次。
en: He {works out|trains|exercises} at the gym three times a week.

zh: 即使我们落后，她也从不放弃。
en: She never {gives up|quits} even when we're losing.

zh: 我停下来系鞋带，只好冲刺去追上其他人。
en: I stopped to tie my lace and had to sprint to {catch up with|catch up to|catch|reach} the others.

zh: 想玩的话随时加入。
en: Feel free to {join in|join|play|join us|come along} if you want a game.

zh: 我们在半决赛被淘汰了。
en: We got {knocked out|beaten|eliminated} in the semi-final.

zh: 比赛七点半开球。
en: The match {kicks off|starts|begins} at half past seven.

zh: 我儿子正在参加校足球队的选拔。
en: My son is {trying out for|trialling for|trialing for} the school football team.

zh: 受伤之后我正在慢慢把体能练上来。
en: I'm slowly {building up|building|improving|rebuilding|working on|regaining} my fitness after the injury.

zh: 我们去伊甸公园给黑帽队加油。
en: We went to {cheer on|support|watch|see} the Black Caps at Eden Park.

zh: 因为太热，两名选手退出了比赛。
en: Two runners {dropped out of|pulled out of|withdrew from|quit} the race because of the heat.

zh: 他因为危险的铲球被罚下场。
en: He was {sent off|red-carded} for a dangerous tackle.

zh: 去年夏天我开始打网球了。
en: I {took up|started} tennis last summer.

zh: 跑完山路后我彻底累垮了。
en: I was completely {worn out|exhausted|knackered|shattered|wiped out|tired out|stuffed} after the hill run.

zh: 慢点！我跟不上你。
en: Slow down! I can't {keep up with|catch|follow} you.

zh: 我在湿草地上摔倒了，伤了膝盖。
en: I {fell over|slipped over|fell|slipped|fell down|tripped} on the wet grass and hurt my knee.

zh: 他们爆冷战胜了排名第一的球队。
en: They {pulled off|managed|got|scored|had} a surprise win against the top team.

zh: 锦标赛之前我们需要加强训练。
en: We need to {step up|increase|ramp up|lift|pick up|improve} our training before the tournament.

zh: 我们顶住了压力，最后以一分险胜。
en: We {held on|hung on|managed} to win by one point.

zh: 我不太喜欢团队运动。
en: I don't really {go in for|like|enjoy} team sports.

zh: 板球比赛因为下雨取消了。
en: The cricket game was {washed out|rained off|rained out|cancelled|canceled}.

zh: 我去跑步，把那顿大餐消耗掉。
en: I'm going for a run to {work off|burn off} that big dinner.

zh: 希望比赛结束前别下雨。
en: Hopefully the rain {holds off} until after the game.

zh: 她在十公里赛跑中得了第二名。
en: She {came in|came|finished} second in the ten-kilometre race.

zh: 等等我！我走不了那么快。
en: {Wait up}! I can't walk that fast.

zh: 昨天的板球比赛因为下雨取消了。
en: Yesterday's cricket match was {rained off|rained out|called off|cancelled|canceled}.

zh: 最后十分钟，全黑队领先了。
en: The All Blacks {pulled ahead|went ahead|moved ahead|surged ahead|took the lead} in the last ten minutes.

zh: 大家都不看好Warriors队，但他们打进了决赛。
en: Everyone had {written off} the Warriors, but they made the finals.

zh: 她膝盖受伤，已经退出了比赛。
en: She's {pulled out of|withdrawn from|dropped out of} the race with a knee injury.

zh: 比赛下午三点准时开始。
en: The game {kicked off|started|began} at three o'clock sharp.

zh: 天太热，他在健身房晕倒了。
en: He {passed out|fainted|blacked out|collapsed} at the gym because of the heat.

zh: 慢点，我跟不上了！
en: Slow down, I can't {keep up}!

zh: 用完器材后请擦干净。
en: Please {wipe down|wipe|clean} the equipment after use.

zh: 我们有机会见到了几位全黑队的球员。
en: We {got to|were able to|managed to} meet some of the All Blacks.

zh: 跑步前先做点拉伸活动一下身体。
en: Do some stretches to {loosen up|warm up} before your run.

zh: 新西兰队在半决赛被淘汰了。
en: New Zealand were {knocked out|eliminated|beaten} in the semi-finals.

zh: 我冲浪时被一个大浪打翻了。
en: I {wiped out} on a big wave while surfing.

zh: 我报名参加了下个月的半程马拉松。
en: I've {signed up for|registered for|entered} next month's half marathon.

zh: 他吃了两张黄牌，被罚下场了。
en: He got {sent off|red-carded} after two yellow cards.

zh: 他在最后一圈甩掉了对手。
en: He {shook off|lost} his rivals on the final lap.

zh: 全镇的人都支持当地的球队。
en: The whole town {got behind|supported|backed} the local team.

zh: 你支持哪个队？
en: Which team are you {rooting for|cheering for|going for|supporting|backing}?

zh: 我们周六对阵Crusaders队。
en: We're {taking on|playing|facing|playing against} the Crusaders on Saturday.

zh: 六个月我就把跑鞋穿坏了。
en: I {wore out|went through} my running shoes in six months.

zh: 冬天来健身房的人通常会变少。
en: Gym numbers usually {fall off|drop off|drop|fall|go down} in winter.

zh: 他在角落里触地得分。
en: He {touched down|scored} in the corner.

zh: 她脚踝受伤，只好退出了比赛。
en: She hurt her ankle and had to {drop out of|pull out of|withdraw from|leave|quit} the tournament.

zh: 我扭伤了脚踝，只好坐在场边休息了下半场。
en: I hurt my ankle, so I {sat out|missed} the second half.
